title: Servicii de telefonie satelit pentru situatii de urgenta
description: Conform caiet de sarcini CR#30748 rev. 0, anexat la prezenta invitatie. Prevederile caietului de sarcini se refera la abonamente voce si trafic voce (5 minute lunar pentru fiecare telefon), pentru 8 telefoane satelit dedicate raspunsului la urgenta. 48 luni de la semnarea contractului de catre ambele parti, dar nu mai devreme de data de 01 August 2020. Oferta va contine propunere tehnica si propunere financiara. Propunerea tehnica va face referire la toate cerintele si precizarile din caietul de sarcini anexat. Propunerea financiara va contine pret pentru servicii de telefonie prin satelit-abonament lunar voce; pret trafic voce; valoarea totala a ofertei (fara TVA), modalitati si conditii de plata. Oferta va fi insotita de urmatoarele documente: copie certificat constatator emis de Oficiul National al Registrului Comertului (ONRC); declaratii privind neincadrarea in prevederile art.72,73,177 si 180 din Legea 99/2016 (modele anexate). Nu se accepta oferte alternative/partiale. Valabilitate oferta: 90 zile de la data depunerii ofertei. Pretul cel mai scazut Oferta va fi transmisa la Societatea Nationala Nuclearelectrica-Sucursala CNE Cernavoda, Serviciul Achizitii Servicii si Lucrari, persoana de contact Valentina Nistor,e-mail: valentina.nistor@cne.ro. Alternativ, oferta poate fi transmisa la nr.de fax 0241 239 006 sau prin posta la adresa SN Nuclearelectrica, Sucursala CNE Cernavoda, Str. Medgidiei nr.2, jud.Constanta, cod postal 905200,Pavilion 0, telefon 0241 803883. Termenul limita pentru depunerea ofertelor: 01.07.2020 ora 15:00. Riscul nedepunerii ofertei in termen prin utilizarea mijloacelor alternative apartine ofertantului.

title: DEVELOPMENT OF E-/W-BAND SLOW WAVE STRUCTURE BREAD BOARDS FOR HIGH POWER TWTS EXPRO+
description: Objective: To develop a E-/W-band traveling wave tube slow-wave structure breadboard capable of delivering 100 W of output power.Description: The millimetre wave domain is also known as the extremely high-frequency (EHF) spectrum ranges from 30 to 300 GHz. Early works on atmospheric propagation in EHF evidenced encouraging future usage for satellite communications. The allocated W-band for satellite services (71-76 GHz and 81-86 GHz) potentially provides a favourable attenuation window due to low oxygen absorption. The exploitation of W-band may offer broad bandwidths for high data rate information transfer. Hence the development of the high power amplifiers is a critical building block that acts as an enabler to exploit this frequency band for satellite telecommunications. Currently, solid state power amplifiers cover this frequency band, but with output powers significantly lower than 100 W and very low efficiency. A traveling wave tube amplifier (TWTA) solution offers better performance in terms of output power and efficiency. This activity aims at developing a traveling wave tube slow-wave structure in W-band, capable of delivering 100 W of output power. As a result of the validation of this key building block, European industry will gain crucial knowledge and pass a first important milestoneon their way to design and manufacture full TWTs in this frequency band. At present, no W-band space TWTs are available in Europe. This activity encompasses the following tasks: - Design a traveling wave tube slow-wave structure in W-band, capable of delivering 100 W of output power - Manufacturing of a breadboard - Testing and validation of a breadboardDeliverables: Breadboard, Report
